Re-derive it by running every seed in `seeds` through stage 6 in the editor -- run_unreal_script Content/Python/pyg_probe_t9_seeds.py with {"start": 1, "count": 150}, which replays pypcg/stages/s06_districts on the inputs recorded in Saved/Reports/v2/s06/slim_7.run.json with the demo overrides and the editor's own booleans -- then summarizing with pypcg.v2.
graph_params: the demo-level overrides, Tools/pypcg/data/demo_overrides.json for PCG_3_1_1_Districts
metric: relative error of the run's sum against the official sum, per tag (length for splines, area for polygons); bbox overshoot is how far the run's bounding box leaves the official one, in metres on the worst side, floored at 0
what_it_shows: The split ratio is drawn from Python's own RNG over the official range [0.3, 0.7]. CollectorRoads' length error runs -7.8 % to +24.7 % with a +8.7 % median and no run below -8 %, localRoads' runs -12.8 % to +15.8 %: an unbiased spread, not a systematic over-cut. A margin of 200 m leaves the official bounding box on 4 of the 6 tags, the worst being LargeDistricts at 458 m.

units.length_rel/area_rel: relative error of the run's sum against the official sum
units.bbox_overshoot_m: metres, worst side, rounded to 0.1, floored at 0
units.median_of_5_pass_rate: share of 4000 random 5-seed samples whose MEDIAN relative error is inside the limit (the protocol's statistic), random.Random(20261016)
